name: ais-referral-decide
description: Writes an underwriter's referral decision back into evari-mordor AIS. Started by a RECORD trigger on cip_referral_decision (node id record:cip_referral_decision — colon, so the id stays one subject token; see hub commit bfb3da01c). Sets the SAME answers a human underwriter would set, so mordor's own collations (CHANGE_UW_DECISION, UNDERWRITER_APPROVED/DECLINED/INFO_REQUESTED) send the existing SendGrid emails, de-index BR_REFERRALS and apply the quote unlock. No email is authored here. Then moves the task to the matching column.

payload.code:
(() => { const tp = String(topicPrefix); const ans = (t, v) => ({ topic: tp + '/' + t, body: { value: v, isTouched: true } }); const env = (answers) => ({ command: 'multi-upsert-answer', subject: '$QUESTION/ANSWER', topic: tp, body: { answers } }); let fields = [], button = [], taskStatus = '', comment = ''; if (decision === 'accept') { fields = [ans('CIP_BR_Underwriting_Decision_Trigger', 'ACCEPTED')]; button = [ans('CIP_BR_Update_Underwriting_Reason', true)]; taskStatus = 'approved'; comment = '**Referral accepted** and written back to AIS. The quote is unlocked and the acceptance email has been sent by AIS.'; } else if (decision === 'decline') { fields = [ans('CIP_BR_declination_reason', String(declineReason || '')), ans('CIP_BR_Underwriting_Decision_Trigger', 'DECLINED')]; button = [ans('CIP_BR_Update_Underwriting_Reason', true)]; taskStatus = 'declined'; comment = '**Referral declined** and written back to AIS. AIS has sent the decline email.

> ' + String(declineReason || ''); } else if (decision === 'request_info') { fields = [ans('CIP_BR_information_requested', String(info || ''))]; button = [ans('CIP_BR_send_information_request_button', true)]; taskStatus = 'awaiting_broker'; comment = '**More information requested** from the broker. AIS has sent the request-for-information email.

> ' + String(info || ''); } else { throw new Error('unknown decision: ' + decision); } if (notes) { comment += '

_Underwriter notes:_ ' + String(notes); } return { fieldsBody: env(fields), buttonBody: env(button), taskStatus, comment, quoteNumber: String(quoteNumber || ''), taskId: String(taskId || ''), stampedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; })()

data.name: Log in to mordor as the AIS integration user
Press the mordor button that fires the collation
Move the task to the decided column
Record what was sent to AIS
Stamp the decision record as written back
